test_title: PYST 24: SSC CHSL 2023 - English (Held On: 09 Aug, 2023 Shift 4)
subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate idiom for the given situation.**

Don't annoy or irritate Raghav, otherwise he will oppose our proposal in the meeting.
solution: The correct answer is: **Rub in the wrong way** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • "**Rub in the wrong way**" means to irritate or annoy someone. (किसी को परेशान या परेशान करना) • **Example**: *The constant criticism from his supervisor tends to rub him in the wrong way, making the work environment stressful for him.* • The phrase is often used to caution against doing something that will make someone angry or upset. • In the given situation, the speaker is warning against annoying Raghav because it could cause him to oppose their proposal in the meeting. • The phrase "rub the wrong way" is a common idiom in English, and is often used in both formal and informal situations. Therefore, the correct answer is **option 3**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** • "**Pass the buck**" means to avoid responsibility or pass a problem on to someone else. (जिम्मेदारी से बचने या किसी समस्या को किसी और पर डालने के लिए) • "**Pour oil in troubled water**" means to calm a tense or difficult situation. (किसी तनावपूर्ण या कठिन परिस्थिति को शांत करना) • "**Loose the ground**" means to experience a loss of support, stability, or advantage. (समर्थन, स्थिरता, या लाभ की हानि का अनुभव करना) 35:Tbf7, The correct answer is: **Attract**
